summary: Ran backend critical regressions plus new validation safeguard tests, and frontend landing/workspace integration checks. Backend suites passed after updating one stale FAR arithmetic assertion. Frontend auth/workspace flow is blocked by CORS, and landing hero frame progression does not reach all 60 frames.

ui_bugs.issue: Frame progression did not reach full 60-frame range during hero scroll; observed max around frame 41 and reverse did not return to earliest frame.
Duplicate data-testid found: 'brand' used multiple times (non-unique test id).

integration_issues.issue: Browser login fails with Network Error due to CORS: frontend origin 909b... is blocked by backend for REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL apt-sync-changes host.

action_items: Fix backend CORS allow_origins so deployed frontend origin (https://909b4d78-4933-4f1a-8a74-e16c30ef1eba.preview.emergentagent.com) is allowed when frontend points to https://apt-sync-changes.preview.emergentagent.com.
Align frontend/backend env routing strategy (either same-origin /api routing or explicit allowed origin list) to unblock auth/login and workspace integration.
Investigate ScrollScene progress/frame mapping so hero scroll can traverse full frame set (1..60) and reverse back to earliest frame.
Make data-testid values unique for repeated Brand instances (nav/footer).
After CORS fix, re-run workspace flow tests: project creation, module navigation, persistence, stale/recomputing banners, 422 retry behavior, and 409 conflict controls.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS middleware currently hardcodes localhost origins + single FRONTEND_URL fallback; this is brittle for preview deployments and caused hard auth integration failure.
FRONTEND_URL env fallback in CORS should fail-fast or support explicit multi-origin config to prevent silent cross-origin runtime failures.
Landing scroll animation logic appears stable/no-blank, but effective frame reachability is incomplete versus requirement to traverse all 60 frames.

success_rate.frontend: 55% (landing + parameter directory validated; auth/workspace blocked by CORS)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST projects in automated backend and UI flows; UI cleanup could not be completed due auth/CORS integration failure.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use seeded admin credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Backend critical suites are green with updated far_test assertion and new validation_safeguards_test. Frontend login on preview failed due CORS between frontend origin 909b... and backend host apt-sync-changes. Landing checks passed for sticky/no-blank/reduced-motion/fallback resilience, but full 60-frame traversal did not reproduce.
rca of the issue: Repro steps (auth): open /login on 909b preview, enter admin@aptimizer.com / Aptimizer@2026, submit. UI shows Network Error; console shows CORS preflight failure on https://apt-sync-changes.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/login and /api/auth/me with missing Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Root cause: backend CORS allow_origins in server.py only includes localhost + FRONTEND_URL fallback and does not include current frontend preview origin. Repro steps (landing frame range): scroll through hero after frame preloading; canvas data-frame increases but max observed around 41, then reverse returns around 26, not full 60->1 progression. Mitigation: correct CORS origin config strategy and revisit ScrollScene progress/frame mapping and decode/progress coupling.
